introduction: The world is filling with low effort AI content… but we’d rather quit than make AI slop. That’s why
lead_intro: Are you ready to test your knowledge about the Human Era Calendar and the special 10-year anniversary edition? Take this quiz to see how much you've learned!

quiz.question: What year does the Human Era Calendar start from?
quiz.explanation: The Human Era Calendar starts from 12,000 years ago at the dawn of human civilization.

quiz.question: What special connection do the stories in the calendar focus on?
quiz.explanation: The stories in the calendar focus on our special connection to the stars.

quiz.question: How many pages is the first-ever kurzgesagt artbook?
quiz.explanation: The first-ever kurzgesagt artbook consists of 120 pages, containing 10 years of kurzgesagt art.

quiz.question: What sets apart the kurzgesagt products from AI content?
choices: They are made by real humans
quiz.answer: They are made by real humans
quiz.explanation: kurzgesagt products are made by real humans, who put in effort, love, and research into creating them.

quiz.question: What do the creators hope you will value over 'AI Slop'?
quiz.explanation: The creators hope that you will value real, human-made content over AI-generated content.
